explication: Blackbird is a CLI OSINT tool for finding accounts associated with usernames or email addresses, then reviewing and exporting the results. Its main workflow loads platform definitions, applies filters and site-specific checks, and asynchronously searches platforms; optional AI analysis profiles the names of found sites. The README also documents CSV/PDF exports, JSON output and HTML dumps. The graph reflects the sampled search, HTTP, list and AI code; some export wiring is documented but its callers were not fully sampled.
